item.title: Hudson River Trading doubles its GPU cluster for model training
item.description: Hudson River Trading has expanded its GPU cluster to more than 4,000 Nvidia H200 GPUs, according to people familiar with the buildout. The firm said training time for its deep learning models had become a bottleneck.

item.title: Two Sigma CTO says inference latency is now the firm's biggest constraint
item.description: Speaking at a conference, Two Sigma's chief technology officer said inference latency is now the biggest constraint on the firm's models, and that general-purpose CPUs can no longer keep up with the models researchers want to deploy.

item.title: Jane Street launches new machine learning trading strategy
item.description: Jane Street has launched a new machine learning driven trading strategy in options markets, staffing a team of researchers to run it.

item.title: DRW says compute constraints are limiting its models
item.description: DRW's head of research said compute constraints are limiting the size of models the firm can run in production, and that it is evaluating custom hardware.

item.title: Tower Research Capital builds out FPGA team
item.description: Tower Research Capital is hiring FPGA engineers to expand its hardware acceleration team in New York.

item.title: AQR Capital Management publishes paper defending the value factor
item.description: AQR Capital Management published a new research paper arguing that the value factor remains attractive after a decade of underperformance.

item.title: Optiver trader talks poker and probability on podcast
item.description: An Optiver trader discussed poker, probability and career advice for graduates on a popular finance podcast.

item.title: Jump Trading expands FPGA research team
item.description: Jump Trading is hiring FPGA engineers for its research team in Chicago.
